name: Capped Fist
description: Drop a heavy flat-topped fist onto the target's guard with a pillar of cloud qi behind it.

name: Stacked Guard
description: Pile layer on layer of cloud qi before the chest so that each layer eats part of a blow.

name: Billow Slip
description: Roll sideways in a billow of cloud qi that carries the body out of a thrust's line.

name: Cloudtop Read
description: Lift a thin layer of qi high overhead and learn from its shifts who moves above and about.

name: Anvil Crush
description: Bring a dense capped column of qi down on the shoulders to crush the stance flat.

name: Dim Shade
description: Cast a wide dim shade of cloud qi that swallows the force of blows aimed beneath it.

name: Anvil Descent
description: Let a vast flat anvil of cloud qi fall onto the ground before the user and flatten all within it.

name: Towering Mantle
description: Raise a towering mantle of storm qi round the user and allies that guards them and quickens their blows.

name: Shearwind Palm
description: Drive a palm across the opponent's body with two qi layers sliding past each other in it.

name: Crosswind Ward
description: Set a crosswind of qi against the direction of attack so that thrusts are blown off line.

name: Shear Slip
description: Slip through the gap between two moving layers of air to pass beside a blow.

name: Slice Rain
description: Flick a thin blade of fast rain qi that slices the outer cloth and skin of the target.

name: Needle Slice
description: Draw a narrow line of fast qi through the guard that cuts rather than pushes.

name: Parting Draft
description: Part an attack with a draft split in two so the attacker's balance is torn sideways.

name: Shear Snare
description: Stretch two opposed currents round the limbs so the opponent is held between their pull.

name: Shearing Torrent
description: Gather opposing rain currents overhead and bring them together to slice the ground around the user.

name: Sundering Layer
description: Slide one layer of qi over another across the opponent's chest to tear his stance and strike.

name: Eyewall Palm
description: Strike with a palm that spins around the centre of the user's field and lands with its full ring of force.

name: Ring Step
description: Move round the opponent in a smooth ring step that keeps the user always at the edge of the guard.

name: Spoke Cast
description: Cast a spoke of hard rain qi from the palm that flies straight out of the turning ring.

name: Eyewall Guard
description: Hold the rim of the turning field before the body so that attacks are flung wide of it.

name: Eye Calm
description: Draw the stillness of the storm's centre into an ally to ease pain and slow a racing pulse.

name: Ring Crash
description: Throw the ring of the field outward in one crash that batters everyone near the user.

name: Eye Pull
description: Pull the opponent toward the calm centre on an inward wind so he cannot leave his stance.

name: Tight Orbit
description: Keep the body inside a tight orbit of qi that guards and also carries it between attackers.

name: Raging Ring
description: Keep a violent ring of storm qi turning about the field so that all within it are battered and held.

name: Quiet Core
description: Hold the calm centre of the field over the user and allies so that it shelters them and mends strain.

name: Twinned Fist
description: Throw two fists in the same breath each wrapped in its own small cloud of storm qi.

name: Cloud Pair Guard
description: Raise two clouds of qi side by side with one to take a hit and one to back it.

name: Double Slip
description: Slip aside twice in quick pairs of steps so that no single swing finds the body.

name: Twin Drizzle
description: Loose two fine sprays of qi-charged drops that cross in front of the target.

name: Paired Burst
description: Strike once with each cloud so two bursts of thunder qi meet inside the target.

name: Pair Veil
description: Cross the two clouds to turn a blow from either side and send it past the user.

name: Twin Thunderhead
description: Bring two towering clouds together over the target so that their crash falls as one blow.

name: Cloud Pair Barrier
description: Hold the two clouds as a double barrier so that a blow breaking the first meets the second.

name: Stoop Fist
description: Dive from a leap with the fist leading and a crack of thunder qi at the moment of contact.

name: Pinion Ward
description: Spread both arms like wings with a screen of storm qi stretched between them.

name: Stoop Step
description: Drop from a higher stance in one fast step that gains ground along the descent.

name: Talon Spark
description: Hook the fingers like talons and throw a fork of lightning qi from the tips.

name: Stooping Bolt
description: Dive a narrow bolt from above that pierces the guard and strikes the head or shoulder.

name: Billow Lift
description: Ride a rising current of qi from the ground to gain height in a single bound.

name: Raptor Cry
description: Loose a piercing shriek of thunder qi that scatters the opponent's attention and his aim.

name: Thunder Stoop
description: Fall from height with the whole stored thunder in the legs and strike the target at a single point.

name: Wingspread Ward
description: Spread a wide pair of storm wings over the user and a companion that turn aside strikes from above.

name: Twin Squall
description: Meet the target with two small squalls from both hands that join at the point of impact.

name: Bowl Shield
description: Cup the hands before the body to hold a bowl of still qi that drinks in an incoming hit.

name: Flow Step
description: Pour the weight along a line of moving qi in a long smooth step that gives no sign.

name: Current Cast
description: Cast a streaming current of wet qi from one palm with the other palm steering its path.

name: Twinned Reading
description: Read the user's two storm fields together and feel what disturbs the space between them.

name: Quench Touch
description: Rest a cool palm on an ally's burn or fever and let the damp qi draw the heat away.

name: Linked Flash
description: Flash a bolt from one field into the other through the target's body to jolt its muscles.

name: Paired Wind
description: Turn two opposed winds against an attack so it is swung out and past the user's flank.

name: Tempest Link
description: Join an ally's qi to the user's second field so that his strikes carry a lick of storm.

name: Twin Tempest
description: Raise two storm fields and let them collide above the target in one wide ruinous break.

name: Reverse Current
description: Run the second field backward against the first so the user is guarded and the allies are fed.

name: Sworn Fist
description: Punch with a fist sworn to the wind so that the storm qi rides the blow without waver.

name: Vowbound Guard
description: Hold a promise-bound screen of qi that does not give while the user keeps the vow.

name: Windbound Step
description: Take a pace with the wind and let its push finish the stride beyond the leg's reach.

name: Sworn Rain
description: Throw a thin sworn rain that runs slantwise and finds the gap in the opponent's cover.

name: Plateau Squall
description: Stamp on level ground and loose a low squall that runs flat out from the user in all directions.

name: Storm Heading
description: Hold a taken bearing and turn off an attack along it without losing the line to the target.

name: Sworn Storm
description: Call the whole sworn storm into a single blow that strikes the target and breaks outward around him.

name: Pledge Mantle
description: Cover the user and sworn companions in a mantle of oath-bound storm that steadies their hands.

name: Bearing Fist
description: Strike along a bearing fixed by sound so that the fist lands where the thunder pointed.

name: Thunder Count
description: Count the delay between flash and peal of the user's own small storm to place a foe by distance.

name: Tether Step
description: Step along a steadily held line toward or away from the target without drifting off it.

name: Peal Guard
description: Ring the forearms with a deep peal of qi that shakes a blow into harmlessness.

name: Bearing Bolt
description: Throw a short bolt of lightning qi that tracks the bearing and strikes the held point.

name: Follow Bolt
description: Send a bolt that bends after a moving target along its bearing and pierces the guard.

name: Clap Bearing
description: Clap on the bearing of the opponent and shake his footing with the shock.

name: Fixed Course
description: Hold to a fixed course through a blow and turn it aside while the feet keep their line.

name: Thunder Reckoning
description: Reckon the target's bearing and strike with all the thunder the field holds in one blow.

name: Unfailing Peal
description: Cast a bolt after a long peal that cannot lose its bearing and pins the target as it pierces.

name: Oathstorm Fist
description: Throw a fist that holds a scrap of the sworn storm and bursts it on the target.

name: Free Ward
description: Hold an open ward of moving air that gives way to a hit and then closes on its force.

name: Roaming Step
description: Walk freely across the field in long loose steps that no single line of attack can pin.

name: Stormfield Sense
description: Spread the sworn weather out wide and feel every body that crosses its open ground.

name: Sworn Downpour
description: Call a sworn downpour down on the field that pelts all foes while sparing the user's side.

name: Wide Draft
description: Open a wide draft in front of the body to sweep a thrown weapon off its path.

name: Oath Pressure
description: Lower the full sworn weight of the weather on one opponent until he stoops under it.

name: Weather Command
description: Command the weather over the whole field to press down on foes and strike them at once.

name: Sworn Sky
description: Hold the sworn sky above the field so that storm strikes foes and strengthens the user's companions.
